programmes.amount_note: Refinance scheme with a BDT 500 crore central fund, plus 1% of each scheduled bank's annual operating profit contributed to bank-level startup funds. Loans are extended to startups at a concessional rate (capped at 4% to the borrower) with a ceiling in the order of BDT 10 crore per startup, without collateral.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are made to a scheduled bank in Bangladesh, which lends under the Bangladesh Bank Startup Fund circular. Confirm the current ceiling, tenor and interest cap in the latest SMESPD circular.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach a scheduled bank operating the Startup Fund.
Submit the business plan and required documents.
Bank appraises under the Bangladesh Bank Startup Fund policy and sanctions the loan.
Refinance is claimed by the bank from Bangladesh Bank.

eligibility.other_note: Bangladeshi entrepreneurs, broadly aged 21-45 at first application, with an innovative and scalable business. Collateral-free. The exact age band, tenor and ceiling are set in the operative Bangladesh Bank circular - verify before applying.

programmes.name_local: Bangladesh Venture Capital Limited (BVCL) pre-seed investment
programmes.name_en: Bangladesh Venture Capital Limited (BVCL) pre-seed investment
programmes.amount_note: Pre-seed and seed equity investment into Bangladeshi startups. Ticket sizes are negotiated per deal.

eligibility.other_note: Bangladesh-registered startups. A private fund, included because public co-investment and donor programmes frequently route through it.

programmes.funder: Innovation Design and Entrepreneurship Academy (iDEA) Project, ICT Division, Government of Bangladesh
programmes.amount_note: Pre-seed grant to early-stage or newly established ventures; publicly documented awards include BDT 10 lakh (BDT 1,000,000) per startup, along with co-working space and mentoring support.
programmes.deadline_note: The iDEA portal carries a live 'Apply for Startup Grant' route. Round-specific deadlines are published on the portal; the project has run several application rounds.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the startup grant application with the business idea and team details.
Screening and evaluation by the iDEA selection panel.
Grant disbursed in tranches with co-working space and mentoring.

documents_required.doc: Trade licence or company registration where applicable

eligibility.other_note: Bangladeshi early-stage and newly established ventures. Read the iDEA Standard Operating Procedures on the portal for the current round's detailed criteria.

programmes.source_snippet: The provision of coworking space, mentoring support, and a generous grant of BDT 10 lakhs has propelled our startup towards success

programmes.funder: Innovation Design and Entrepreneurship Academy (iDEA) Project, ICT Division, Government of Bangladesh
programmes.amount_note: Grant support to small and medium ICT-based entrepreneurs for expansion. Amounts are set per round in the iDEA Standard Operating Procedures.
programmes.deadline_note: A live 'Apply for SME Grant' route is published on the iDEA portal; round-specific deadlines are announced there.

eligibility.other_note: Bangladeshi ICT-based small and medium enterprises seeking expansion capital.

programmes.name_local: SME Foundation credit wholesaling and enterprise development support
programmes.name_en: SME Foundation credit wholesaling and enterprise development support
programmes.funder: SME Foundation, Ministry of Industries, Government of Bangladesh
programmes.amount_note: Concessional credit wholesaled through partner banks and NBFCs to small and medium enterprises, plus training, cluster development and market access support. Loan ceilings are set per programme.

eligibility.other_note: Bangladeshi SMEs with a valid trade licence; women entrepreneurs receive dedicated allocations.

programmes.funder: Startup Bangladesh Limited, ICT Division, Government of Bangladesh
programmes.amount_note: Government-sponsored venture capital company investing equity in Bangladeshi startups from pre-seed through Series A. Capitalised with a government allocation of BDT 500 crore; individual ticket sizes are negotiated per deal.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications for investment are accepted on a rolling basis through the Startup Bangladesh website; the company also runs periodic thematic calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the pitch through the Startup Bangladesh website.
Due diligence and investment committee approval.
Term sheet, definitive agreements and disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Bangladesh-registered companies with a scalable technology-enabled business model and a founding team based in Bangladesh.
